heal_pokemon_helper.description: Talks to Nurse Joy and heals the player's Pokemon party, bypassing the auto-advance mechanism. Standing at (3,3) facing Up is required.

history.commit_message: Create a custom tool to heal Pokemon at Pokemon Centers without triggering auto-advance.

flee_battle.description: Generates the button press sequence to select the RUN option from the default battle fight menu (Down, Right, A).

history.commit_message: Define a simple custom tool to automate navigating to the RUN option in battle.
